stem:
A class is making a poster about the sun. The poster includes drawings and information about the sun.
Which statement should the students include on the poster?

options.label: A
options.text: The sun has a solid, rocky core.

options.label: B
options.text: The sun is one of the largest stars in the universe.

options.label: C
options.text: The sun is farther from Earth than some other stars are.

options.label: D
options.text: The sun is located on a spiral arm of the Milky Way galaxy.
